issues.description: The datasheet requires exporting the SAS panel to Stata and conducting the main analyses there, but this package contains no Stata source, export/import procedure or analysis input schema. The SAS code ends with two WORK subsets; paper-described state fallback/exclusions and forecast/8-K zero-filling cannot be assigned to a supplied stage.

The datasheet requires Audit Analytics derivative-lawsuit data, but neither supplied SAS file reads a lawsuit table or shows its firm mapping/merge. The current local Audit Analytics legal-case/company-party feeds are candidates only; author-specific population, date and identifier rules remain unknown.

The datasheet describes merging Appel UD Laws data but the supplied SAS code does not read that input. It cites Appel (2016) in the data-handling section and Appel (2015) Table 1 in the workflow steps; exact source/table, layout and GVKEY merge are unresolved.

The datasheet names Thomson Reuters institutional ownership as a control input, but controls.sas has no visible Thomson/TFN read or ownership measure construction. TFN.S34 is only a catalog candidate and its bounded probe timed out; the required measure/fields remain unspecified.

The supplied SAS expects FLAG values and FNDATE/LNDATE/CONM from wciklink_gvkey. The current local WRDSSEC.WCIKLINK_GVKEY candidate exposes source/link dates and names instead; no field/status mapping is established. Do not rename or substitute fields without the release-specific definitions.

The annual and quarterly width programs require First Call actual EPS records; no exact local product route is verified.

actions.description: Acquire and convert the verified SRAF 10-X header dataset for the header input.
steps: After data-acquisition authorization, obtain the SRAF 1993-2025 header CSV from the cited repository page.

Filter the author-required 10-K variants and 1995-2007 report years; map filer_cik, company name, incorporation state, business state, filed date and conformed report period to the SAS header schema without substituting submission CIK for filer CIK.
Preserve duplicates/multiple filer rows until the author’s deduplication and historical CIK-link rules are confirmed.
validation: Check the downloaded CSV metadata and required source columns, then validate 1995-2007 10-K coverage, period/date mappings and state-field missingness before conversion into the legacy SAS input.

actions.description: Validate the local Compustat candidate against both author SAS input contracts and required history.
steps: Confirm whether local COMP.FUNDA can reproduce the author-specific wrds.compustat_1985_2015 input and its field types/identifier conventions.
Verify fyear 1980-2011 coverage for controls and 1985-2011 for the main panel; retain the ten-year prior-ROA window and five-observation rule.
Do not infer full-period coverage from the one-row probe or catalog observation metadata.
validation: Check the required columns and historical fiscal-year coverage using a future authorized bounded metadata/date-coverage procedure; then validate derived control inputs for target years.

actions.description: Use the verified local standard CRSP CCM, STOCKNAMES, MSF and MSI routes; resolve the separate legacy ERMPORT1 source.
steps: Use the matching standard local CCM, STOCKNAMES, MSF and MSI products; exact author download-vintage identity is not required. During routine execution QA, check date-specific CCM links, CUSIP/NCUSIP match rates and the code-required twelve-month windows for actual control rows.
Identify the exact CRSP.ERMPORT1 source or author-confirmed equivalent and its decret/capn fields; do not guess a replacement table.
Preserve the code’s historical CUSIP/NCUSIP matching and exact twelve-month prior-return construction.
validation: Run standard field/format and required-date checks for the readable local products as ordinary input QA; confirm ERMPORT1 field provenance before building controls.

actions.description: Use the supported local 8-K item product and resolve the separate legacy CIK-GVKEY link-schema gap.
steps: Use readable local WRDSSEC.ITEMS8K as the verified standard source for the 1995-2007 tests. Confirm its test-period slice and the supplied NITEM categorization in ordinary input QA; identical bytes to the 2017 extract are not required.
The alternate WRDS SEC Analytics Suite routes require subscription, but the replicator’s entitlement is unknown; do not treat them as blocked absent an actual denial or evidence of absent access.
Ask the authors to specify how legacy FLAG values 2/3 and FNDATE/LNDATE/CONM map to current CIK-GVKEY link fields before changing any SAS code.
If local raw SEC filings are considered for 8-K construction, obtain the exact form/item extraction and identifier-link rules before treating that route as compatible.
validation: Perform normal input checks for the 1995-2007 8-K item slice and NITEM treatment. Resolve CIK-GVKEY link-key/date/flag semantics against the SAS consumer before running; do not require byte identity to the author extract.

actions.description: Resolve the captured SAS runtime startup failure without changing or running author code.
steps: Have the SAS runtime environment administrator review the recorded TKELS Launch Service load failure and establish a working SAS 9.4 command/runtime.

actions.description: Run the supplied controls producer before the main SAS program in the same session so WORK.controls persists.

A separate SAS session between these programs would lose WORK.controls.

review_notes: Only full_pipeline is assessed. gvkey.csv is a one-row-probed gvkey/cyear identifier list, not a complete analysis dataset; no analysis_only route is established.
The work-item checklist omits visible controls.sas reads of CRSP.MSF, CRSP.ERMPORT1 and CRSP.MSI; these are manually included as separate data requirements.

The documented author workflow cites Audit Analytics, Appel UD Laws and Thomson Reuters ownership, but the complete supplied SAS code has no corresponding read/producer; these remain unresolved rather than independently reconstructed.

The local SEC/LM roots were checked only by bounded directory stat. No recursive listing or population coverage was examined. LM 10-X and parsed/exhibits paths were not treated as complete 8-K or MD&A-only inputs.
The supported visible producer order is controls.sas then blw_jar_code.sas in the same SAS session because the consumer reads the WORK.controls table. The later Stata analysis/export is absent.

Local one-row probes establish bounded readability/columns, not complete history/population. The exact standard CRSP products and WRDSSEC.ITEMS8K match the supplied source contracts and required fields/types, so the local routes are treated as compatible; required-date, match-rate, format and population checks are ordinary future input QA, not a demand for a full-data sweep or identical author vintage. The official WRDS subscription condition does not establish this replicator’s entitlement or lack. Catalog misses and the TFN probe timeout are not proof that data or licenses are absent.
